rules.sentence: The US imaging shows a non-specific mass, associated with hypoechogenic and hyperechogenic heterogeneous areas, along with calcifications or ossification, relatively hypovascular, and sometimes may present a pseudocapsule formation with tendency to invade adjacent structures.

The US scan shows a well-circumscribed oval hypoechogenic mass, with increased posterior enhancement, and may be seen as variable degree of anechoic areas due to necrotic, cystic changes and hemorrhage, with intralesional Doppler increased blood flow.
The rhabdomyosarcoma US imaging lacks specificity; can feature a heterogeneous irregular well-defined mass with low to medium echogenicity and may have anechoic irregular areas in zones of necrosis.
